now.detail: Pages is up on the public mirror. Emulator pixel shimmer fixed, both outputs labelled, capture library added. Next is the dither parity test unless you redirect me.

next.why: Fixed images through JS and PIL, assert identical output. Keeps the emulator honest without you maintaining two implementations. Not blocked -- starting this next unless redirected.

next.task: Decide what to do about print duration
next.why: The emulator measured about 56s to print one photo. 26.3s of that is pure serial time at 9600 baud. Raising the baud rate is the obvious lever.

blocked.why: doodek/thermal-cam is private and is still the origin. evrenucar/thermal-cam is the public mirror that Pages serves. Pushing to both is manual for now -- say the word if you want one to become canonical.
